top_signals.title: Yen Climbs to Six-Month High, Chip Stocks Advance: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: The yen extended Monday’s rally to reach the strongest level since February, aided by rising expectations of a Bank of Japan interest-rate increase next week. Gains in South Korean chip stocks helped support Asian equities.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs pull in $987 million last week as institutional demand recovers
top_signals.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs drew in $3.52 billion in net inflows in August, their largest monthly positive flows since September 2025.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
